complementary_spitzer9.rights: arXivv1 explicitly CC-BY-NC-ND4.0, distinct from any journal or data-license terms. Do not infer raw-observation redistribution rights. KMT public policy permits post-proprietary publication with required citation/acknowledgment; automatic event data are not the paper-specific re-reduction.
availability_gaps: Full reduced OGLE/MOA/KMT/Spitzer native rows, masks and covariance not recovered in this bounded inventory.
GSA photometry lacks supplied sigma; no invented sigma assigned.
No measured Gaia epoch astrometry supplied by this paper; simulations are excluded as observations.

known_isolated_BH_microlensing_benchmark.role: Only literature-confirmed isolated stellar-mass BH found in this bounded microlensing inventory, with multiple reductions of ONE event.
known_isolated_BH_microlensing_benchmark.known_positive_literature_evidence: Angular microlensing plus photometric parallax and lens-light limits; published mass is not imported as a measurement or optimizer target.

positive_count_evidence: Huston2026 sections1,7 explicitly describe only one confirmed isolatedBH, OB110462.
Sep2026 GalacticBH census arxiv2609.14154 includes one isolatedBH; no additional microlensing positive was located by the bounded primary search.
search_limits: Not a proof of absence of every publication/catalog. This is a source-bounded inventory as of2026-10-22. No unrelated X-ray/dynamical/GW binaries or simulations are substituted as microlensing truth.
next_admissible_work: Separately validate a photometric parallax route on all59 with each native version/failed availability explicit; mass needs actual angular information or independently measured relative lens-source motion. Recover complete angular/native metadata for any new joint cohort before freezing its likelihood. No published mass becomes a datum or target.
BHSM_interpretation: One ordinary compact-lens Einstein/GHY optical exterior counted once; no added core/envelope potential. Photometric parallax alone does not identify mass, horizon, core, absolute distance or membrane deformation.
